question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Titan
solution:
The correct answer is: **Giant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Titan **refers to a person or thing of great strength, size, or achievement. (दैत्य)

 
 
• **Example**: *The businessman was considered a titan in the industry, having built a massive empire.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Giant **refers to a creature, object, or person of enormous size or power. (विशाल)
 
 
• **Example**: *The mountain was surrounded by giant trees, creating a breathtaking natural landscape.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Midget**" is used to describe individuals of short stature. (बहुत छोटा चित्र)
 
• "**Predator**" refers to an animal or person that preys on others, often for food or in a harmful manner. (हिंसक जानवर)
 
• "**Puny**" means small, weak, or lacking in strength or size. (छोटा आकार का)
